🎭02 / Audience & Sound EffectsLaughs · Cheers · Fart · Birds · Kiss · more⌄

🎭 Audience & Sound Effects

Every audience sound plays over the scene you chose; no sound button changes studios. All cues are together here, including 💨 Fart → 🐦 Birds → 💋 Kiss. Press Birds again to stop birds. Music stays in the separate Music area.

🎙️ My Audience Sounds — Upload · Record · Download

Choose which reaction you want to customize. Record your own sound or upload an MP3/WAV, then download your clip to keep a backup. Your reaction button will play your new sound.

Select an effect, then record or upload a sound. You can download your custom clip afterward.
🔒 Your recordings stay on this device. Microphone permission may require a secure browser page; if recording is blocked, use Upload Sound instead. Keep your own downloaded backups.
55%

🎙️ My catchphrase • your real voice!

Type a saying for a broadcast pop-up. Record it with your microphone or choose a voice clip; clicking Put phrase on screen plays the saved recording too. No robotic voice is generated.

Type a phrase and record your voice, or use the visual banner without audio.
🔒 Recording stays on your device in this browser when storage is available. Your microphone is used only while you're recording. Emergency tones are fictional entertainment effects, not real emergency alerts.
🎧 Optional real-audience recordings

Laugh, Aww, Applause and Cheer can use real recordings (the online defaults may be unavailable). The News button and the seven new show effects have original sounds built into this file and work offline. Pick an MP3/WAV/OGG below for any reaction to use your own audio offline. Your clips are saved in this browser when storage is available.

🎚️ Optional: customize individual sound clips
😂 LaughterPeople laughing, not a spoken “ha ha”Default: online real laughter
🥹 AwwwwwNatural “ooh / ahh” voicesDefault: online real crowd reaction
👏 ApplauseReal people clappingDefault: online real applause
🎉 Crowd cheerActual cheering voicesDefault: online real cheering
🚨 News alertInstrumental, no speechDefault: built-in offline chime

Need offline audience audio? Download a recording from the credits links below, then choose the saved file for the matching button. If a recording cannot load, the graphic still appears and the studio gives a clear message. Note: the clean pop-out broadcast window is visual; keep the control-room audio routed into OBS.

Sources and permissions for included streaming recordings

Recorded by humans, from Wikimedia Commons. Public-domain recordings: Laughter by ezwa; Ohhh Ahhh by starlite; Applause i by thore; Hurray by starlite. The offline news chime is original. User-provided clips are their responsibility to license for broadcasting.

Ready for your first reaction!
🎥 Using your camera

Click Enable camera, allow access, then choose a framed camera box or a green-screen cutout. The cutout works best with an actual green background and even lighting.

📺 Streaming with OBS

Pop out the clean stage and capture that window using OBS Window Capture. This prototype does not broadcast to Facebook or YouTube by itself.

📝 Show Script & Broadcast Plan

Your private notes for introductions, real stories, music cues, jokes, and kindness challenges. They are NOT shown on the broadcast screen.

Your notes save on this device as you type. For an extra backup, download a .txt file.

Tip: press Ctrl + V (or long-press and Paste on a phone) if your browser blocks the Paste button. You can also select and copy any passage with your keyboard. Verify true stories before broadcasting; label comedy as fiction.

📼 Saved shows & video editor (test)

Finished shows save to this browser when your device has room, and still download as backups. Choose a show or import a video. Mark the unwanted section and cut it, or replace its sound with a bleep. Export makes a new copy in real time; your original stays untouched.

Play to find the word. Pause just before it and mark Start; pause just after it and mark End. You can adjust the seconds below.
